summary: Approved. The consumer guide, external Angular fixture, credential-scoped workflows, BuildKit Dockerfile, static invariants, and streaming image inspector satisfy DS-1. The protected workflow remains the appropriate place for authenticated installation and Docker-layer verification.

evidence.description: Reviewed commit b9e36125f2d674a8dc3f48d3f4e05b876ae35475 on feat/private-consumer-docs against the approved DS-1 plan.
Static fixture checker and yarn check:private-consumer passed; diff --check reported no whitespace errors.
Independent streaming tests confirmed a credential-bearing stream exits 1 without printing the token, a clean stream exits 0, and an absent token exits 2.
Manual protected workflow scopes the repository secret per step, uses BuildKit --secret, and inspects both saved image data and docker history.
